# Relax Tax & Business Services

> Family-owned tax preparation, bookkeeping, payroll, tax planning, and IRS representation firm serving Plano, Texas and all of Collin County (including Allen, Frisco, and McKinney) since the early 1990s.

Relax Tax & Business Services is a family-run firm offering:
- Tax Preparation
- Bookkeeping
- Payroll
- Tax Planning
- IRS Representation

Location: 2000 North Central Expy., Suite 115, Plano, TX 75074
Phone: (972) 732-0081
